info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Status API enables users to access the current status of pharmacy prescriptions efficiently. By utilizing this API, healthcare providers and pharmacists can monitor prescription fulfillment, ensuring timely patient care. The primary resource is the prescription status, which can be queried to provide real-time updates for specific prescriptions. This API is essential for electronic health record systems and pharmacy management solutions that require immediate access to prescription information.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the current status of prescriptions in the system. It provides insights into whether prescriptions are active, completed, or require further action.

requestBody.description: Contains the necessary data to request the status of prescriptions. Refer to the schema for details on the expected format and fields.

201.description: Resource successfully created and status updated.
